sentences.en: They watched the runner's triumphant jaunt across the finish line.
sentences.zh: 他们看着那位选手得意洋洋地冲过终点线。

sentences.en: Lestrade met us, his face flushed with victory, his manner grossly triumphant.
sentences.zh: 莱斯特雷德见到我们，脸上满是胜利的红晕，举止得意非凡。

sentences.en: Camillus returned to the city triumphant.
sentences.zh: 卡米卢斯凯旋而归，回到了这座城市。

senses.zh: 胜利的, 成功的; 喜气洋洋的, 欢欣鼓舞的
